findings.finding: begin reads context.sourceId/state.getEntity/copiableEntryCard; absent token gives silent zero copies, departed copied card reads reverted original, blink reads a new visit. Does not select LKI by exact origin.
createTokens requires live sourceId/container/card before using preparedEntry. Repairing plan selection alone cannot copy a cleaned-up source token.

EntitySnapshot captures projected P/T/types/colors/keywords/counters and definition id, not complete copiable CardComponent or DFC. Registry reconstruction loses copy exceptions/creation text; projected reconstruction wrongly copies noncopy effects.

Reusable transport: actual departure snapshot is frozen before copy reset/strip, stored on exact-origin pending block/cast triggers and stack abilities, and persisted as LastKnownPermanentComponent. First matching departure is retained.

sourceSnapshotForTrigger selects only exact origin-object matches from pending trigger, trigger context or LastKnownPermanentComponent. EffectContext.forTriggeredAbility carries it; activation handler uses actual self-sacrifice departure before earlier cost snapshot.

DealDamageExecutor is the nearest source-information identity/LKI precedent: original object, matching departure snapshot, explicit missing-data failure. resolveTarget(Self) is an actionable reference API that rejects departed sources; copying requires information from them.

forAbilityResolution/withCurrentObjectReferences capture and recheck identity; authorizeObjectMoves threads first matching departure into same-resolution Composite context. sourceReferenceLost does not mean copy instruction may vanish.
Existing two Stormsplitter tests only cover live-source multiplication; they do not test departed tokens, copy changes, stale visits or serialized LKI resumption.

Preserve projected fields for damage/predicates. Default-null legacy data means unavailable history, not permission to invent it.

Capture predeparture material through existing copiableEntryCard and face-down/DFC rules, before copy reset/face-down cleanup. Keep ZoneTransitionService, EntitySnapshot.fromProjection and state-aware captureEntitySnapshots consistent at source snapshot sites. Actual departure overrides earlier trigger/cost observation.

Add one engine-level source-copy information selector. Original expected battlefield ObjectRef still present: use live current copiable values. Otherwise require matching departure snapshot with complete copy payload. Prefer context-carried snapshot; exact-origin LastKnownPermanent fallback is acceptable. Never match only EntityId.

Preserve distinction between source information and actionable Self. Do not use sourceReferenceLost as no-copy; do not use resolveTarget(Self) as sole selector. Preserve origin independently of permittedMoves. Explicit same-effect object-following exceptions require causal controls; do not broaden generic action tracking in this fix.

Populate PendingTokenEntries from selected immutable material, applying instruction copy exceptions/owner once and freezing choices/DFC before suspension. Source branch no longer needs present source entity.

Prepared createTokens must depend on prepared material rather than current sourceContainer. Descriptive source name/provenance for delayed triggers comes from captured material/context. Route legacy direct constructor/resumer paths through same selector or prove they cannot receive departed sources.
